# CASE-2026-041 — Incident Timeline  
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | CASE-2026-041 |
| Document ID | CASE-041-TIMELINE |
| Version | 1.0 |
| Reporting Date | 2026-07-05 |
| Owner | Incident Commander |
| Status | Open — reconciliation pending |
| Supersedes | None |
| Superseded By | None |
| Related Documents | [[case_2026_041_overview]], [[case_2026_041_complaint_record]], [[case_2026_041_retention_decision]], [[incident_response_plan]], [[technology_production_runbook]] |  
| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 2026-07-02 09:18 UTC | Monitoring alert detects anomalous export access |
| 2026-07-02 09:42 UTC | Severity 2 and Incident Commander appointed |
| 2026-07-02 10:42 UTC | Service disabled and logs preserved |
| 2026-07-02 14:30 UTC | Security logs identify 120 potentially affected customers |
| 2026-07-04 16:20 UTC | Operations finds 118 confirmed affected customers |

raw_entities.name: CASE-2026-041 — Anomalous Export Access Incident
raw_entities.description: A security incident involving anomalous export access detected on 2026-07-02, affecting customer data. The case remains open with reconciliation pending between Security's initial count of 120 potentially affected customers and Operations' confirmed count of 118. Remediation actions include patch deployment, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership assignment.
context: Case ID | CASE-2026-041
Status | Open — reconciliation pending
Monitoring alert detects anomalous export access
Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure

raw_entities.name: Monitoring Alert — Anomalous Export Access Detected
raw_entities.description: Initial detection of anomalous export access via monitoring alert on 2026-07-02 at 09:18 UTC, triggering the incident response process.
context: 2026-07-02 09:18 UTC | Monitoring alert detects anomalous export access

raw_entities.name: Severity Classification and Incident Commander Appointment
raw_entities.description: Incident classified as Severity 2 and Incident Commander appointed on 2026-07-02 at 09:42 UTC to lead response and coordination.
context: 2026-07-02 09:42 UTC | Severity 2 and Incident Commander appointed

raw_entities.name: Service Disabled and Logs Preserved
raw_entities.description: Containment action executed on 2026-07-02 at 10:42 UTC to disable the affected service and preserve forensic logs for investigation.
context: 2026-07-02 10:42 UTC | Service disabled and logs preserved

raw_entities.name: Security Logs Analysis — Initial Customer Count Identified
raw_entities.description: Security team analysis of logs on 2026-07-02 at 14:30 UTC identified 120 potentially affected customers based on export access patterns.
context: 2026-07-02 14:30 UTC | Security logs identify 120 potentially affected customers

raw_entities.name: Operations Reconciliation — Confirmed Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Operations team reconciliation on 2026-07-04 at 16:20 UTC confirmed 118 affected customers, creating a discrepancy with Security's initial assessment of 120.
context: 2026-07-04 16:20 UTC | Operations finds 118 confirmed affected customers

raw_entities.name: Failed-Download Events Sent for Forensic Validation
raw_entities.description: Two failed-download events escalated for forensic validation on 2026-07-05 at 09:00 UTC to support root-cause analysis and reconciliation efforts.
context: 2026-07-05 09:00 UTC | Two failed-download events sent for forensic validation

raw_entities.name: Security Initial Assessment — 120 Potentially Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Security team's initial impact assessment conducted on 2026-07-02 at 14:30 UTC, identifying 120 potentially affected customers based on anomalous export access logs.
context: 2026-07-02 14:30 UTC | Security logs identify 120 potentially affected customers

raw_entities.name: Operations Reconciled Assessment — 118 Confirmed Affected Customers
raw_entities.description: Operations team's reconciled impact assessment conducted on 2026-07-04 at 16:20 UTC, confirming 118 affected customers through detailed account-level validation.
context: 2026-07-04 16:20 UTC | Operations finds 118 confirmed affected customers

raw_entities.name: Patch Deployment
raw_entities.description: Technical remediation action to deploy a patch addressing the anomalous export access vulnerability, required before case closure.
context: Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure

raw_entities.name: Peer Review
raw_entities.description: Quality assurance control requiring peer review of the patch and remediation approach before deployment, ensuring technical and operational soundness.
context: Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure

raw_entities.name: Account-Scope Validation
raw_entities.description: Validation action to confirm the precise scope of affected accounts and reconcile the discrepancy between Security's 120 and Operations' 118 customer counts.
context: Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure

raw_entities.description: Post-remediation monitoring period of 30 days to detect any recurrence of anomalous export access or related security events.
context: Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure

raw_entities.description: Assignment of root-cause investigation and remediation ownership to a designated team or individual, required before case closure.
context: Remediation: patch, peer review, account-scope validation, 30-day monitoring, and root-cause ownership before closure
